title: Human Risk Register (Ground Truth Extraction)
description: Contract for the HUMAN-AUTHORED register extracted as ground truth (data/ground_truth/<project_id>.json). Relative to output_schema.json (generation): likelihood, impact, and mitigation are OPTIONAL because real registers often omit them; mitigation may legitimately be "none stated"; and there is no evidence field (evidence traces a model output to the planning doc and is generation-only).

project_id.description: Identifier of the project, matching data/corpus_manifest.csv.

risks.description: One entry per risk in the human register.

risk_id.description: Stable identifier unique within this register, e.g. R01, R02.

description.description: The risk as stated in the human register.

category.description: Mapped to exactly one of the fixed categories (map the register's own taxonomy onto these).

likelihood.description: 1-5 if the register states it (or maps cleanly to 1-5); null if not stated.

impact.description: 1-5 if the register states it (or maps cleanly to 1-5); null if not stated.

mitigation.description: The stated mitigation. Use "none stated" (or null) when the register genuinely lists no mitigation for this risk.
